When Melissa joined Kyle Denton and me on InnerVerse, we explored the premise that spirit precedes form, and homeopathy demonstrates that principle as plainly as anything I know. RMDY makes quality remedies and first aid kits accessible, prepared with real care for who makes the medicine and how.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Jim's Egg Shaped UFO Encounter", "body": "Jim described a night in Walla Walla, Washington, after a long drive during which he first heard Coast to Coast and decided to try meditating to call a UFO. He said he pictured the Eiffel Tower in the thought realm above his head, saw nothing, and went to bed. After a phone call near three in the morning he went outside, heard cows mooing wildly, and saw a glowing amber egg shaped craft that followed the contour of the ground toward the Blue Mountains. Jim said it sent him into years of UFO research, and he wondered whether it was an entity, a coincidence, or knowledge still waiting to hatch."}, {"title": "Seraphim, Watchers and Serpent Beings", "body": "Chance argued that stories of seraphim, watchers and flaming serpents might describe beings who observe and create on a spiritual level without limbs to move things in the physical world, and he compared them to the robots humans build for strength and speed. He said Eastern dragons looked like chakras without arms, and he linked the word dragon to a Greek root meaning to watch. Jim added a friend's account of a serpent shaped dragon seen in the desert near Bend, and Chance told of beach ball sized white orbs that he and two others saw rise from the ground at a 2017 eclipse festival in Missouri."}, {"title": "Chance's Cosmic Egg and Electric Universe", "body": "Chance walked through an artwork he called an updated cosmic egg, with a central column as the spine of the universe and nested ring worlds, each with its own sun and moon. He stressed it was not dogma and suggested that a periodic outward push of the middle ring might explain giants and the mud flood. Jim said the model fit stories such as The Smoky God and the world tree, and even his own egg shaped UFO. He then raised electric universe ideas, quoting Nikola Tesla that everything is electricity, frequency and vibration."}, {"title": "Jim's Path, Goats and a Baphomet House", "body": "Jim said he built sculptures, oversaw a wax art and mold making shop, and kept goats and chickens, and he told how he raised three orphaned goats by bottle before bringing them back to his shop. He said he and SB Alger drew crowds talking conspiracies at a bar and decided a show might be fun, after which Alger took part in a flat earth debate streamed from Jim's basement. Jim also said a bartender's Baphomet necklace set off a chain of events that ended with him buying his grandparents' old house, closing on 9/11."}, {"title": "Saturn Return, Tarot and Laughter", "body": "Chance drew a King of Swords from his tarot deck and said it fit how the conversation had cut through confusion, while a chat viewer read it as cutting through illusion. Chance read from a book on the Tarot and said the egg and world tree model made him see death as hopping from one womb to another. He then explained the Saturn return as a time to build discipline across all twelve houses, claiming that self care before and after it brings visible rewards. Chance and Jim agreed that laughter was central to the show."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: James Maiden of Weaving Spiders Welcome joins Vibe Rant. Aside from being an arachnoid analyst of all things archonic, he's also got an epic and infectious laugh, so join in the fun and help us crack up like crack-spiders.
